name: Site Search 360
description: Crawler for the Site Search 360 hosted site-search product, operated by Zoovu (Germany) GmbH, formerly SEMKNOX. It indexes the pages of the customer sites it is pointed at, following links from the configured root domains and skipping external hosts. Robots.txt is not applied automatically: the control panel offers a "Fill Blacklist from robots.txt" action that imports a site's disallow rules into the crawl blacklist, and the crawler honours noindex robots meta tags. The operator publishes the addresses it crawls from for firewall allowlisting.
